subject: LedgerPath production degradation — rollback requested
messages:
From: Alyssa Cho <alyssa@ledgerpath.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Berg <cto@ledgerpath.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Spike in latency + 502s after model update (urgent)

Hi Mateo —

We started seeing a significant increase in p95/p99 latency and a spike in 502 errors after the 03:00 deployment that moved LedgerPath to model v3.2 with the new quant profile Q2.

Symptoms:
- p95 increased from ~120ms to ~620ms; p99 frequently breaching 1s (dashboard attached).
- 502 errors at ~4.8% of requests during peak (approximately 11:30–14:00 PT).
- Throughput dropped ~18% under normal load, causing backpressure in our request queues.

This is customer-impacting (payment auth flows). Please escalate — Marcus is on this thread. We need either an immediate rollback or a mitigation that we can apply from our side while you investigate.

Attached: system-traces-20261119.log, latency-dashboard-20261119.png

Thanks,
Alyssa Cho
Head of Payments Integrations, LedgerPath
alyssa@ledgerpath.com
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Cho <alyssa@ledgerpath.com>
Cc: Marcus Berg <cto@ledgerpath.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Spike in latency + 502s after model update (urgent)

Alyssa —

Sorry you're hitting this. I'm escalating to our on-call infra + inference team (cc'd). We've received the traces and will triage immediately. Initial questions while we pull telemetry:
- Do you have a short sample of request payloads that produced 502s?
- Was traffic routed through any new edge rules at your end between 11:00–14:00 PT?

We're treating this as Sev2 -> escalating to Sev1 if degradation persists. I will update within 30 minutes with the first findings and mitigation options (rollback / canary / config tweak).

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Customer Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Alyssa Cho <alyssa@ledgerpath.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Spike in latency + 502s after model update (investigating)

Thanks for the trace, Alyssa. Quick summary of what we've found so far from the first-pass analysis:

1) Deployment details: model v3.2 (family = v3), quant profile Q2 applied to reduce memory footprint. Release tag: model-v3.2-quant-Q2, rolled to 100% at 03:10 PT.

2) Observed behavior:
- Inference kernel CPU/GPU scheduling shows a 2.5x increase in model memcpy time for longer-context requests (>=1024 tokens) under Q2. That bumps per-token wall time and increases KV-cache eviction churn.
- Error pattern: 502s correlate with timeouts in our backend worker pool when memcopy + attention kernel latencies exceed configured RPC timeout (1200ms).
- Throughput: effective qps per-worker dropped ~20% for hot endpoints (matches LedgerPath's traces).

3) Hypothesis: Q2 changes some weight packing that, for the particular input length distribution LedgerPath uses, degrades kernel throughput and increases async RPC timeout probability.

Immediate mitigations we are preparing:
- Canary rollback to quant profile Q1 (previous) for a small shard to validate latency/502 delta.
- Temporary traffic shaping: shift high-length requests to a dedicated pool with increased timeouts while we evaluate.
- If canary validates improvement, plan full rollback to Q1 and re-run quantization tuning offline.

I've attached a short snippet of the trace correlation and a link to the internal incident (INF-5321).

Rishi
Senior Inference Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alyssa Cho <alyssa@ledgerpath.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Berg <cto@ledgerpath.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Spike in latency + 502s after model update (urgent)

Mateo / Rishi —

Thank you for the quick analysis. LedgerPath cannot sustain elevated 502s during peak. Our legal/ops teams are asking for an immediate rollback to the previous serving profile while you investigate. Marcus has also asked to loop in Redwood leadership if this isn't addressed in the next hour.

Please confirm ETA for a canary rollback and whether this will require a maintenance window. We need clear communications to our customers if there's any risk of degraded auth success rates.

Alyssa
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Cho <alyssa@ledgerpath.com>, Marcus Berg <cto@ledgerpath.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Spike in latency + 502s after model update (planning rollback)

Alyssa / Marcus —

We are proceeding with a controlled canary rollback to quant profile Q1 on one serving shard at 17:05 PT (in 20 minutes). Plan:
- 17:05 PT: apply Q1 to shard-7 (10% traffic).
- 17:10 PT: shift to 30% if p95 < 200ms and 502s < 0.5%.
- 17:20 PT: shift to 100% if metrics remain stable.
- 17:40 PT: post-rollback verification and close loop.

This does not require customer-visible maintenance; we'll do traffic shifts to avoid connection drops, but we'll send a status update at each step. If we see any regressions during canary, we will abort and escalate to a full rollback with a brief maintenance window.

I'll update after the first metric collection at 17:12 PT.

—Mateo
Customer Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

(Pinging Marissa and Irene for exec awareness and approval for a full rollback if canary succeeds.)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Cho <alyssa@ledgerpath.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Berg <cto@ledgerpath.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 18:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Spike in latency + 502s after model update (executive update)

Alyssa / Marcus / team —

Thanks for the rapid engagement. Per Mateo/Rishi the on-call runbook is in motion; we have authorization to proceed with a full rollback to Q1 if the canary at 17:05 shows the expected improvements.

Next steps (executive summary):
- Canary result: p95 dropped to ~130ms, p99 under 350ms, 502s reduced to 0.2% on shard-7 within the first 7 minutes.
- Action: initiating staged full rollback to Q1 (traffic ramp to 100% over 15 minutes) starting at 18:05 PT.
- Customer comms: Mateo will send status updates at roll milestones; we will provide a postmortem within 48 hours that includes root cause, remediation, and a plan to avoid future Q-profile regressions.

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: postmortem-template.docx (will be filled and shared after incident closure).
